offering_description.value: BioMarin develops and sells prescription medicines for rare genetic disorders to specialty pharmacies, hospitals, and public health systems. It develops and manufactures biologic therapies and supplies its medicines through specialty distribution and direct institutional sales.

primary_products.value: Enzyme replacement therapies for inherited disorders; growth therapy for achondroplasia; enzyme substitution therapy for phenylketonuria; oral treatments for Fabry disease and phenylketonuria

customer_segment.value: B2B: Specialty pharmacies, pharmaceutical wholesalers, hospitals, and infusion centers; B2G: Public hospitals and national health system procurement agencies

end_markets.value: Rare genetic disease care; inherited metabolic disorders; pediatric skeletal disorders

revenue_model.value: product sales: Prescription medicines sold to specialty distributors, pharmacies, hospitals, and public health systems

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Develops drug candidates into approved medicines and manufactures biologics for specialty distributors and healthcare institutions

geography_served.value: global: United States, Canada, Europe, Latin America, and Asia-Pacific

specialization.value: related lines: Enzyme therapies, skeletal growth treatment, and oral medicines for rare genetic disorders

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: Specialty pharmaceutical distributors and wholesalers; third-party retail: Specialty pharmacies that dispense medicines to patients; direct sales: Hospitals and government procurement agencies in some markets
distribution_channels.category: distributors / dealers; third-party retail; direct sales

regulatory_exposure.value: high: Prescription drugs require approval, manufacturing quality controls, and postmarket safety monitoring under FDA, EU, and other national rules.
